resources.string: Runs user-imported Rusted Warfare desktop files through Fabric on Android.
The game environment is ready. Continue your game through the same Fabric runtime used on desktop.
Import your desktop game files and the ARM64 Java runtime once, then you can launch directly from here.
No diagnostic tests have been run.

This Android launcher is free software under GNU GPL version 3 and is provided without warranty. The APK does not contain Rusted Warfare game files.

Third-party Java mods are executable code running with this application’s permissions. Rusted Fabric does not review or endorse unknown third-party mods. Install only code you trust and keep backups.
The packaged license could not be read.

Java mods are executable code, not passive resource packs. They run inside the game/Loader process and may access files or the network, expose private data, damage saves or the installation, cause cheating or multiplayer incompatibility, or compromise this application’s data. Android’s application sandbox does not isolate Java mods from this launcher or the imported game.\n\nRusted Fabric does not automatically review, warrant, or endorse third-party mods. Install only mods from sources you trust, inspect source and checksums when possible, and keep backups. You accept responsibility for loading third-party code.
A Java mod runs as executable code with the game/Loader’s permissions. Only continue if you trust its author and download source. Rusted Fabric has not verified unknown third-party mods.
Game binaries and Java stay in this app’s private directory. User mods and maps are stored in the shared rustedWarfare folder. Rusted Fabric does not bundle or distribute Rusted Warfare.

Rusted Fabric stores INI mods, maps, and Java mods in Internal storage/rustedWarfare so file managers such as MT Manager can edit them and the game can hot-reload INI changes. Android requires one-time “All files access” permission for the desktop JVM to read these ordinary files.

Installing a newer launcher APK over this app keeps the imported game, Java runtime, user mods, maps, and settings. Bundled official mods are updated automatically.
